reservation_rule: Reserve the worst-case successful-request input cost before transport; never refund a reservation after transport or crash.
notes: 65,536 is used as a conservative binary interpretation of the documented 64k context limit.
At $0.042 per million input tokens, one reservation is ceil(65536 * 0.042) = 2753 micro-USD.
Output tokens are documented as free for Jev 1.13.
The official pricing source is revalidated before every paid provider transport; source drift fails closed.
